## Motivation

- Two ROCm Kimi-K3 env vars break the [env var conventions](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.agents/skills/env-var-conventions/SKILL.md):
  - `SGLANG_AITER_K3_OPT` is read with `get_bool_env_var`, so it is not in `Envs`, cannot be overridden in tests and is not documented.
  - Neither name has a verb after `SGLANG_` (`AITER_`, `K3_`).
- Renaming now, with aliases, lets recipes move to the conventional names before the old ones are removed.

## Modifications

| Old name (still accepted) | New name | Kind | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `SGLANG_AITER_K3_OPT` | `SGLANG_OPT_HIP_K3_AITER` | perf toggle | `false` (unchanged) |
| `SGLANG_K3_RADIX4_TOPK` | `SGLANG_OPT_HIP_K3_RADIX4_TOPK` | perf toggle | `false` (unchanged) |

- Both new names are `EnvBoolWithAlias` fields with the old name as `deprecated_name` (env-var-conventions Rule 5), so existing scripts keep working.
- Every read site uses `envs.<name>.get()`.
- Both entries sit in the existing AMD, ROCm, and AITER section of `environ.py` and the AMD & ROCm table of the env reference. The `SGLANG_OPT_HIP_K3_AITER` description now matches the code.
- Values are parsed by `EnvBool`: `yes` / `y` now count as true, and an unrecognized value raises instead of warning and reading as false.
- Renames that belong to other open PRs stay there, so the PRs merge in any order:
  - fused KDA decode (`SGLANG_USE_HIP_K3_KDA_FUSED_BACKEND`, `SGLANG_USE_HIP_K3_FLYDSL_SOURCE`): #41794
  - KDA in-proj (`SGLANG_OPT_HIP_K3_FUSE_KDA_INPROJ*`): #44362
- The cookbook keeps the old names, because the pinned image `v0.5.19-rocm720-mi35x-20260916` only reads those.
- When only the old name is set, the shared `Env*WithAlias` code copies the value to the new name in `os.environ`. All aliases in `Envs` do this; this PR does not change it.

## Accuracy Tests

- No numerical change: both switches keep their code path and default.
- `test/registered/unit/test_environ.py` checks both aliases:

| Case | Expected |
|---|---|
| Old name only | New field returns the old value, one `DeprecationWarning` |
| Both names | New name wins, no warning |

- On MI355X, `test_environ.py`, `test_moe_route_radix4.py` and `test_topk_correction_bias_cache.py`: 78 passed. pre-commit passes.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

- No speed change expected. Not measured, because no code path changes.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

+class TestKimiK3HipEnvAliases(CustomTestCase):
+    """Launch scripts and the Kimi-K3 cookbook still set the pre-rename Kimi-K3
+    ROCm names, so each must keep reaching its new descriptor."""
+
+    # (new name, deprecated name, old raw, old parsed, new raw, new parsed);
+    # the old value is non-default so a read that ignores the alias shows up.
+    ALIASES = [
+        ("SGLANG_OPT_HIP_K3_AITER", "SGLANG_AITER_K3_OPT", "1", True, "0", False),
+        (
+            "SGLANG_OPT_HIP_K3_RADIX4_TOPK",
+            "SGLANG_K3_RADIX4_TOPK",
+            "1",
+            True,
+            "0",
+            False,
+        ),
+    ]
+
+    def _get(self, name):
+        with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as caught:
+            warnings.simplefilter("always")
+            value = getattr(envs, name).get()
+        return value, [w for w in caught if w.category is DeprecationWarning]
+
+    def test_deprecated_name_is_read_with_warning(self):
+        for new_name, old_name, old_raw, old_value, _, _ in self.ALIASES:
+            # The old name has no descriptor, and patch.dict also drops the copy
+            # the alias fallback writes to the new name.
+            with self.subTest(new_name), patch.dict(os.environ):
+                getattr(envs, new_name).clear()
+                os.environ[old_name] = old_raw
+                value, deprecations = self._get(new_name)
+                self.assertEqual(value, old_value)
+                self.assertEqual(len(deprecations), 1)
+                self.assertIn(old_name, str(deprecations[0].message))
+                self.assertIn(new_name, str(deprecations[0].message))
+
+    def test_new_name_wins_over_deprecated_name(self):
+        for new_name, old_name, old_raw, _, new_raw, new_value in self.ALIASES:
+            with (
+                self.subTest(new_name),
+                patch.dict(os.environ),
+                getattr(envs, new_name).override(new_raw),
+            ):
+                os.environ[old_name] = old_raw
+                value, deprecations = self._get(new_name)
+                self.assertEqual(value, new_value)
+                self.assertEqual(deprecations, [])

> @yuychang

## CI Status for PR #45314

**Verdict:** None of the 10 executed failures were caused by this PR. In every executed job the PR only swaps how a flag is read, and the value it reads (`False`) is the same as before. Four failures come from the PR branch's base, which is older than current `main`, and `main` has already fixed them. PR CI is incomplete: the NVIDIA `base-b` and `base-c` stages in `pr-test.yml` never ran.

> [!WARNING]
> **NVIDIA CI did not finish.** In `pr-test.yml` ([run 39391724646](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39391724646)), the gate job [wait-for-base-a](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39391724646/job/119000384241) failed because of the `base-a-test-cpu` fixture failures below. As a result, `base-b-test-*`, `base-c-test-*`, `wait-for-base-b`, `call-pr-test-extra`, the kernel jobs and the multimodal jobs were all skipped. Rebasing onto current `main` should clear the `base-a` failures and let these stages run.
>
> **The flag-on path was not tested.** The behaviour this PR touches only runs on Kimi-K3 with ROCm, `SGLANG_USE_AITER=1` and the flag set. The only tests that turn it on are `test_kimi_k3_eval_mi35x.py` and `test_kimi_k3_perf_mi35x.py`, and both are registered as nightly-only (`register_amd_ci(..., nightly=True)`). So PR CI only exercised the default-off path.

**Executed failures:** AMD: 5 (0 related) · Others: 5 (0 related)

**Why the change is inert in every executed job:**
- The PR replaces `get_bool_env_var("SGLANG_AITER_K3_OPT")` with `envs.SGLANG_OPT_HIP_K3_AITER.get()` (D3, D5, D7).
- That getter defaults to `False` and only checks the deprecated alias when the new name is unset (`python/sglang/srt/environ.py:161-185`).
- Neither name is set in any CI image `ENV`, in the exec env (F*.env), or anywhere under `.github/`, `scripts/` or `docker/`.
- So `_aiter_k3_opt` is `False` before and after the PR. On non-HIP runners the expression stops at `_use_aiter` (`False`) and never reads the variable.

### AMD Executed Failures
| Job | Test | Failure | On `main` | Related? | Why |
|-----|------|---------|-----------|----------|-----|
| [extra-a-test-1-gpu-small-amd (rocm10, mi300)](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39391724619/job/119000403955) | `kv_canary/test_self_e2e_pr_25015.py::TestEaglePositionsMatchWithFix::test_pr_25015_eagle_positions` | Attempt 1: `Memory access fault … Write access to a read-only page` (crash). Attempt 2: `ReadTimeout` after 60 s. Qwen3-0.6B bf16, EAGLE, aiter backend. | No `main` baseline (G1). In 8 other PRs' runs of this job (Oct 20–21, same image `v0.5.22-rocm10-mi30x-20261020`) this test passed every time ([e.g.](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39532251546/job/119000703756)). One of those needed a retry, for a different reason. | 🟢 | **Independence:** the model is unquantized Qwen3-0.6B, so it never builds the mxfp4 / quark-mxfp4 MoE or `kimi_k3`, and the changed flag stays `False` anyway (F1.env, F1.launch). **Against:** this crash mode is new compared with the other PRs' runs (0/8 failed). A GPU fault on one runner ([`linux-mi300-1gpu-sglang-runner-nbh2p`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39391724619/job/119000403955)) looks more like flakiness, but that is not proven. |
